broker.name: Doo Prime
broker.tagline: Its site names FSA (Seychelles), VFSC, and FSC (Mauritius). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: The Doo Prime pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include STP, ECN, and Cent. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and D Prime Mobile App. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), VFSC, and FSC (Mauritius). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Doo Prime Seychelles Limited, SD090. VFSC: Doo Prime Vanuatu Limited, 700238. FSC (Mauritius): Doo Prime Mauritius Limited, C119023907.

plans.name: STP
plans.billing_note: No trading commissions. Spreads from 1 pip. Leverage up to 1:1000. Minimum lot 0.01. Suffix .s. Stop out 10%. Updated 9 October 2026.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Help Center articles say up to 1:1000X.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Help Center, updated 9 October 2026: STP minimum initial deposit is none. Cent says minimum deposit 0 and 'No minimum deposit'. ECN minimum initial deposit is $100. Because the amount depends on account type, no single minimum is recorded.

other_fees.label: Inactive account fee
other_fees.value: USD account $10 per month after 3 months with no trading
other_fees.note: USC account 1,000 USC. JPY account uses the exchange rate on the deduction day. After 12 consecutive inactive months, annual fee is $50 per USD account or 5,000 USC. Zero balance is not charged. Source client agreement defines the company as D Prime Vanuatu Limited.

other_fees.label: Withdrawal handling fee
other_fees.value: 3% if the withdrawal method differs from the original deposit method
other_fees.note: The same client agreement says the company reserves the right to impose this fee. Client pays bank transfer fees and currency conversion.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, licences page, MT4 page, client agreement and Help Center articles fetched on 2026-10-11. The site branding on those pages is often 'D Prime'. Mauritius FSC C119023907 is in the privacy policy updated 15 August 2024. The public licences page lists only Seychelles FSA SD090 and Vanuatu VFSC 700238, and does not mention Mauritius. Older English help URLs under /en/support/solutions/ returned 404. Current Help Center articles were used instead. The mobile app on the homepage is described for account management (open account, deposit, withdraw, transfer), not as a charting platform. No founding year and no headquarters city were stated.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: Licences page names Seychelles FSA SD090 and Vanuatu VFSC 700238 but does not name the companies. Privacy policy updated 15 August 2024 names Doo Prime Seychelles Limited (SD090), Doo Prime Mauritius Limited (FSC C119023907) and Doo Prime Vanuatu Limited (VFSC 700238). The client agreement page defines the company as D Prime Vanuatu Limited, VFSC 700238. No street address or founding year was on the pages fetched. The licences page says 'over 10 years' without a year.
